description: Compose the new DM Mission application into the authoritative Frame Conn feature graph and existing Foundry integration boundary.
planning_goal: Complete the runtime-composition slice of SITREP Phase 6. Load the DM Mission stylesheet through the canonical UI registry, resolve and configure the registered ui-dm-application feature from runtime-orchestrator, inject canonical SITREP and Foundry APIs, expose the DM application through game.lancerFrameConn.dm, extend the existing Foundry getSceneControlButtons owner with one GM-only Mission launcher, expose active Combat/Region/Combatant queries through Foundry Integration, preserve dependency validation, and do not add a second init/ready authority or any direct legacy SITREP dependency.

operations.replace:
closeApplication:
    null,

  openDmApplication:
    null,

  executeLockOnAuthorityRequest:
    null

publishSemanticOutputIntent:
        publishFrameConnSemanticOutputIntent,

      getActiveCombat:
        getFrameConnActiveCombat,

      listCombatRegions:
        listFrameConnCombatRegions,

      listCombatants:
        listFrameConnCombatants,

      diagnostics:

operations.search:
const frameConnSitrepsApi = frameConnFeatureRegistry.getApi("sitreps");
if (!frameConnSitrepsApi) throw new Error("Frame Conn | The registered SITREPs feature API could not be resolved.");

operations.replace:
sitreps:
        frameConnSitrepsApi,

      dm: Object.freeze({
        application: frameConnDmApplicationApi,
        open: (...args) => frameConnDmApplicationApi.open(...args),
        close: (...args) => frameConnDmApplicationApi.close(...args)
      }),
